Name: Everyone wears Japanese clothing
Author: myrtall
Description:
These are PNGs of sprites Oho Davi's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]Stardew Anime Mods[/url] edited to put everyone in Japanese clothing. There's also edits of Poltergeister's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1437]Slightly Cuter Character Sprites[/url]﻿ mod to match the overworld sprites with the portraits. I wanted something with an old-timey feel, so I made the Beach portraits to be traditional swimwear, which is very modest. I am working on making beach overworld sprites to match the portraits.

[b]INSTALL:
[/b]The first file is PNGs only. You need to insert them into the [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] mod.
The second file must be extracted and inserted into your Mods folder.

From Poltergeister's page for Slightly Cuter Character Sprites:
[spoiler] ﻿The configs are as following

whether characters have noses:
﻿"NoNose":"True/False"

[Maru's glasses version is not available]

whether the default farmer base changes.
 ﻿"FarmerBase": "True/False"
If you use this, the legs of the farmer will be a little wider (approximately the same width as with the default pants equipped. As such, there will be no visible difference when you have the default pants equipped). Set it to "False" if you use a different mod which changes farmer bases﻿﻿ such as Get Glam. Get Glam features the same farmer bases I made so you can get the same results using that. [/spoiler]

From Platonymous' page for Portraiture:
[spoiler][u]How to install a portraits mod with Portraiture:[/u]

- Download and install Portraiture for your version of SDV
(If done correctly the manifest.json should now sit in "/Mods/Portraiture/manifest.json")

- Download a portraits mod you want to use for ex. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4745/?]this one[/url] 

- Create a folder in "Mods/Portraiture/Portraits" that you name however you like, for ex. "DCBurger Hi-Res" and extract the portrait files inside it.
(If done correctly the file for Abigail would be located at "/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/DCBurger Hi-Res/Abigail.png")

 - Start the game and talk to someone. Once the DialogueBox is open press P to change portraits till you see the right one. It will also shortly show the name of the folder above the left top corner of the DialogueBox, in this case "DC Burger Hi-Res". Whatever folder you pick will be saved for all portraits and stay that way after reloading until you change it again yourself.[/spoiler]
